notes.title: Resort and Paws DLC Update
notes.content:
Hooray!



The trailer for the new free DLC for Cast Cats is out! 



We also updated the screenshots on the Steam page, so get ready for your vacation with these fluffy kittens!



Released this August!



[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/J7zMDM1Qdtk"][/dynamiclink]

Add to your wishlist so you don't miss out:



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457020"][/dynamiclink]

Stay fluffy and fabulous,

The Cast Cats Team

Patch 1.0.2a is out now.

 Fixed the card carousel didn't spin at startup

notes.title: Gameplay Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2 is out now.

A few bugs were fixed:

 Sliders for audio settings.
 Resizing of borderless window is available.
 The level carousel now scrolls when the game starts.

notes.title: Gameplay Patch 1.0.1a
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1a is out now.

A bug were fixed:

 Fixed a bug where the boss button would appear on top of the game level.

notes.title: Gameplay Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is out now.

A few bugs were fixed:

 Fix Barmaid image.
 Updated blur effect.
 The game locked at 60 FPS as default.


Additional changes:

 Use keys "[" and "]" to change max FPS in a game from 10 to 120.
